description: This file defines the MyTasksDashlet class, a custom dashlet for displaying user-specific tasks in SuiteCRM. It extends the DashletGeneric class, loads dashlet data, and sets up the dashlet's properties like title, search fields, and columns.

classes.name: MyTasksDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashboard component in SuiteCRM that displays a list of tasks assigned to the current user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the MyTasksDashlet class, initializes dashlet properties such as title, search fields, and columns using the loaded dashlet data.
